def _get_numbers_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    num1 = float(num1)
    num2 = float(num2)

    if use_log_scale:
        log_a = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num1) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num1)
        log_b = math.copysign(math.log(abs(num2) + MATH_LOG_OFFSET), num2)
        num1 = log_a
        num2 = log_b

    divisor = (num1 + num2) / max_

    if divisor == 0:
        if num1 == num2:
            result = 0
        else:
            result = max_
    else:
        result = abs((num1 - num2) / divisor)

    distance = min(result, max_)

    if use_log_scale and distance < log_scale_similarity_threshold:
        distance = 0

    return distance
